summary: After three separate attempts to progress past the intro screen (two click_text attempts on 'Start Adventure 🌻' and one precise click_at on its exact center coordinates), the app remains stuck on the same 'Buggy's Garden Market' welcome screen. The button appears clickable (correct dimensions, text, position) and clicks register as 'ok: true', but no navigation or state change occurs - the visible text, title, and interactive elements are identical across all three post-click screenshots. This indicates a functional blocker: the 'Start Adventure' button is non-responsive or the onClick handler is broken, preventing any access to the actual multiplication content (equal groups, arrays, skip-counting word problems). Since the app never progresses beyond the splash/intro screen, no evidence of the first task, error/recovery handling, successful progression, or payoff for the multiplication concept can be gathered. This is a critical blocking bug: a child user would be completely unable to start the adventure despite clear call-to-action instructions ('Tap the button to begin the adventure!'). Recommend immediate engineering investigation into the button's click handler before any further UX evaluation of the multiplication content can proceed.
